package sctp

import (
 "testing"
 "time"
)

func TestResearchRackLostRetransmission(t *testing.T) {
 for _, trigger := range []string{"sack","timer"} {
  for _, test := range []struct{name string; sends uint32; age time.Duration; queued, acked, want bool}{
   {"original",1,100*time.Millisecond,false,false,true},
   {"retry",2,100*time.Millisecond,false,false,true},
   {"repeated-retry",3,100*time.Millisecond,false,false,true},
   {"recent-retry",2,5*time.Millisecond,false,false,false},
   {"already-queued",2,100*time.Millisecond,true,false,true},
   {"already-acked",2,100*time.Millisecond,false,true,false},
  } {
   t.Run(trigger+"/"+test.name,func(t *testing.T){
    a:=newRackTestAssoc(t)
    a.lock.Lock()
    defer a.lock.Unlock()
    now:=time.Now()
    a.rackReorderingSeen=true
    a.rackReoWnd=10*time.Millisecond
    a.rackMinRTT=40*time.Millisecond
    c:=mkChunk(100,now.Add(-test.age))
    c.nSent=test.sends;c.retransmit=test.queued;c.acked=test.acked
    a.inflightQueue.pushNoCheck(c);a.rackInsert(c)
    delivered:=now.Add(-50*time.Millisecond)
    if trigger=="sack" { a.onRackAfterSACK(true,delivered,101,&chunkSelectiveAck{}) } else { a.rackDeliveredTime=delivered;a.onRackTimeoutLocked() }
    if c.retransmit!=test.want {t.Fatalf("retransmit=%v, want %v for latest transmission age %s",c.retransmit,test.want,test.age)}
   })
  }
 }
}

func TestResearchRackDeliveryAmbiguity(t *testing.T) {
 for _, selective:=range []bool{false,true} {
  for _, test:=range []struct{name string; age time.Duration; valid bool}{
   {"old-ack-arrives-before-minimum-rtt",time.Millisecond,false},
   {"credible-retry-ack",80*time.Millisecond,true},
  } {
   name:=test.name+"/cumulative";if selective{name=test.name+"/selective"}
   t.Run(name,func(t *testing.T){
    a:=newRackTestAssoc(t)
    a.lock.Lock();defer a.lock.Unlock()
    a.rackMinRTT=40*time.Millisecond
    a.rackReorderingSeen=true
    a.rackReoWnd=10*time.Millisecond
    now:=time.Now()
    retryTSN,otherTSN:=uint32(100),uint32(101)
    if selective {retryTSN,otherTSN=101,100}
    retry:=mkChunk(retryTSN,now.Add(-test.age));retry.nSent=2
    other:=mkChunk(otherTSN,now.Add(-150*time.Millisecond))
    if selective {a.inflightQueue.pushNoCheck(other);a.inflightQueue.pushNoCheck(retry)} else {a.inflightQueue.pushNoCheck(retry);a.inflightQueue.pushNoCheck(other)}
    a.rackInsert(other);a.rackInsert(retry)
    sack:=&chunkSelectiveAck{cumulativeTSNAck:100,advertisedReceiverWindowCredit:1024*1024}
    if selective {sack.cumulativeTSNAck=99;sack.gapAckBlocks=[]gapAckBlock{{start:2,end:2}}}
    if err:=a.handleSack(sack);err!=nil {t.Fatal(err)}
    if found:=!a.rackDeliveredTime.IsZero();found!=test.valid {t.Fatalf("retry used as delivery evidence=%v, want %v",found,test.valid)}
    if other.retransmit!=test.valid {t.Fatalf("older chunk marked lost=%v, want %v",other.retransmit,test.valid)}
   })
  }
 }
}
